newsitem.title: SPAIN: Marilyn Monroe porn film surfaces in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Marilyn Monroe porn film surfaces in Spain.

text.p: A pornographic short film of Hollywood legend Marilyn Monroe has surfaced in Spain and will be shown at a film festival on February 1 and 2, festival organiser Mario Prades said on Wednesday.
Prades told Reuters the six-and-a-half minute silent film, now owned by an anonymous short film maker from the northeastern town of Manresa, was bought for a few dollars at Paris flea market in 1977.

The grainy black-and-white footage was made in 1947 when Monroe was 21. Chubbier and without the plastic surgery that helped to make her later glamourous image, she is shown doing a striptease and an engaging in an explicit sexual act with a man.
Although the blonde woman in the film barely looks like Monroe, the American Film Institute confirmed in a letter to the film's owner last month that it was indeed her.

Prades said the First Festival of Record and Film Collectors had been bombarded with offers to buy the film. It had been made into a video by the regional government but would not be put on sale until early next year.
He said the only other two known copies of pornographic films made by Monroe were in United States, where Hollywood studios had tried to protect her image by suppressing them.
